Commentary.Commentary: The umpires are on the ground. The fielding team has taken their respective positions on the field. Finn Allen and Devon Conway will open the batting for New Zealand. Sam Curran has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...
Will England bowlers defend a 199 or will the New Zealand batters manage to accomplish their target and level the series? Join us in a while to find out what happens in the chase.

Not much to say about the New Zealand bowlers. Tim Southee and Mitchell Santner took some quick wickets at the start of the innings but after that, they failed to put pressure on the batters in the middle stages. Jonny Bairstow and Harry Brook took them apart quite easily and smashed them around the ground for boundaries. Ish Sodhi came in and took two quick wickets dismissing Harry Brook and Moeen Ali who came in and smashed a maximum off his first ball. Adam Milne was the most economical of the bowlers though he went wicket-less, he gave away only 23 runs off his 4 overs. Some good death bowling under pressure helped them restrict England to under 200. The target for the batters to chase is 199.

England started off well but were pulled back by a few quick wickets of Will Jacks and Dawid Malan. Jonny Bairstow and Harry Brook handled the reigns and dealt some great damage to the opposition’s bowling unit. Both of them completed their half-centuries as they built up a strong partnership of 131 runs. Brook departed after scoring 67. Moeen Ali came in but was also sent back to the pavilion after hitting a six off his first ball. Jonny carried on and scored an unbeaten 86 runs off 60 balls. The skipper, Jos Buttler contributed in the end giving a good finish to the innings. They could not go par the 200 mark but just enough managed to get to 198. Now it is up to their bowling unit to defend this total.

A slower delivery bowled on a good length and in line with the stumps. Jos Buttler looks to swing his bat across the line but misses and the ball goes just over the stumps. The rush across for a bye though and end the innings at 198 for the loss of 4 wickets.

England leads the series 1-0 after winning the last match comfortably with 7 wickets to spare. It was an all-round performance by the team and they dominated the entire match in all the departments. Their bowling department looks strong, especially with Luke Wood and Brydon Carse in form. The spinners, Adil Rashid, Moeen Ali and Liam Livingstone also had a good last match. Sam Curran will try to be amongst the wickets in this match along with scoring some runs. In their batting department, Harry Brook and Dawid Malan scored most of the runs in their last outing while Jonny Bairstow was dismissed for a low score. They have their skipper, Jos Buttler down the order along with Sam Curran and Liam Livingstone to end the innings with some explosive batting. This looks like a very strong white ball team and they will hope to win this match and increase their lead.
